change: submit_trade_plan now prepares deterministic Basis, RiskBudgetReservation, Receipt, Order and LedgerEntry candidates and, when explicitly given a PostgresAutonomyRepository plus caller-owned connection, persists and consumes the complete chain through one savepoint/transaction boundary. Durable attempts use ephemeral candidate registries and never mutate the service's in-memory ledger. A completed chain is returned by deterministic recovery after a new connection/process, and duplicate execution facts are idempotent.

tests.quality_gate_result: 553 contract, 9 property, 2 schema, 1 unit passed; ruff, mypy, secret scan and health passed

verified_behaviors: successful durable submit stores Basis, consumed RiskBudgetReservation, consumed Receipt, Order domain event and LedgerEntry domain event
new service/connection recovers the original Order and LedgerEntry after commit
duplicate submit returns ORDER_ALREADY_CREATED and creates no second business effect
reservation, receipt, order and ledger failure injection rolls back all preceding PostgreSQL writes
durable candidate failure leaves the service's in-memory RiskBudgetLedger empty
acceptance: The durable golden-chain slice is reproducibly verified and included in the final V2-008 acceptance.
